title: A two-scale approach for sampling local free energy minimisers
summary: When a free energy admits several local minimisers, the associated mean-field particle system exhibits a metastable behavior, undergoing random transitions between these minimisers. However, when the number of particles is large, these transitions are rare events and typically occur at a time-scale which is out of reach for simulations. In this work, we introduce a system of particles coupled with a slow macroscopic external variable which approximately follows a Langevin dynamics associated to a coarse-grained free energy.
